definition: Alienate means to cause someone to feel unwelcome or estranged; to lose the support of.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word alienate. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know alienate should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: By mocking the interns' questions in every meeting, the new director managed to alienate the very staff he needed most.
Offend is the milder word—an offended guest may grumble through dinner and still come back next week, while alienating someone drives them away.
Estrange goes further than offend or alienate—estranged relatives may not exchange a word for decades, the breach hardened into settled distance.

Disaffect means to make a group lose its loyalty to a leader or institution — voters, troops, a fan base. Alienate is broader and more personal: you can alienate one friend or a whole staff, and the word stresses that people feel unwelcome and withdraw. Disaffect is lost allegiance; alienate is lost belonging.

Antagonize means to provoke someone into open hostility — the antagonized push back and fight. Alienate points the other way: alienated people rarely fight; they feel unwelcome and quietly take their support elsewhere, often for good. You can alienate people entirely by accident, while antagonizing usually takes deliberate needling.

Alienate is the word for losing people—supporters, friends, allies—through your own actions.
For a one-time insult, 'offend' is enough; reach for alienate when the damage sends people away for good.

When Priya ran for council president, she carried every homeroom; by March, she could not fill a lunchtime meeting.
Nothing dramatic happened -- no scandal, no shouting match.
It was smaller than that: agendas sent late, votes taken before the freshmen arrived, inside jokes at the podium that half the room could not follow.
Each choice seemed harmless, and together they managed to alienate the very students who had campaigned hardest for her.
Her advisor put it plainly: nobody was angry, and that was the problem -- they had simply decided the council was no longer for them, and gone off to found a film club.
